description: A3: Stoneback, the quarry titan, in his quarry beside Millford from the start of the open world - a world boss held by his territory (world.crownmarch.stoneback_territory, TitanTerritory: he sees a giant within 110 m, hunts it to 230 m, then walks home whole). An arena encounter: no leash (the territory is his). His conflicts with the director's rules, solved (EncounterDirector, A3): `reserve_seat` keeps his seat in the 12-combatant budget while a giant is within the activation radius (others wait; if the budget is full when he comes, the farthest other combatant leaves); `lod_near_m` keeps his AI at full rate within 400 m (the 90 m tiers would slow his walk out and his hunt); a chunk unload despawns him without a death and he returns at home, whole. He dies once (persist_death; forbids his outcome flag).
